authority.implementationEvidence: Must be supplied as exact source revisions or a deployed immutable version at execution time.
authority.runtimeEvidence: Must be collected fresh from the approved target; this matrix is not runtime evidence.

journeys.positivePath: Open the approved entry page and reach the sign-in action.
negativePaths: protected application route without a session
requiredEvidence: redirect destination with query values redacted
screenshot without cookies or personal data

journeys.positivePath: Sign in to the dedicated synthetic tenant and load the dashboard.
negativePaths: session bound to an unexpected tenant
journeys.cleanup: sign out and discard the browser session

journeys.positivePath: Read surfaces allowed to an organization member.
negativePaths: application management without the required permission
requiredEvidence: server-side denial when a bounded direct request is safe
journeys.cleanup: sign out; do not change the role during the agent run

journeys.positivePath: Create one application carrying the exact run prefix and synthetic marker.
journeys.cleanup: revoke child credentials, then delete only the exact synthetic application

journeys.positivePath: Enable one pre-approved low-cost model for the synthetic application.
journeys.cleanup: application deletion removes the setting; do not change organization provider configuration

journeys.positivePath: Create one expiring application credential, verify one-time visibility, and bind it directly to the API connector.
negativePaths: full value is not displayed after leaving the creation state
duplicate submission does not create an untracked second key
requiredEvidence: absence of the secret from screenshots and issue text
journeys.cleanup: revoke the exact credential before deleting the synthetic application

journeys.positivePath: GET /v1/models with the synthetic application credential and observe only eligible public model identifiers.
Send one minimal POST /v1/chat/completions request with stream false.
requiredEvidence: request shape with prompt content summarized
token and cost evidence when available

journeys.positivePath: Send one minimal streaming Chat Completions request and observe ordered SSE chunks followed by the terminal marker.
Send one non-streaming and one streaming POST /v1/responses request with minimal input.
Find the four bounded inference requests in the synthetic application's Requests surface and correlate them without exposing prompts or credentials.
negativePaths: member sees data outside its scope

journeys.positivePath: The outsider can access only its own explicitly provisioned empty scope.
requiredEvidence: server-side denial without copying protected data
journeys.cleanup: operator removes the secondary synthetic identity or tenant using its separately approved lifecycle

journeys.positivePath: Revoke the synthetic application credential, verify a bounded request is denied, then remove the exact synthetic application and reconcile inventories.
requiredEvidence: zero unowned residue or an explicit blocker
journeys.cleanup: this is the mandatory terminal cleanup journey

executionRule: Run journeys in order, stop on every abort condition, and never convert blocked or not_tested cases into pass.
